extracted.summary: A private client solicitor administering a £614,000 Harrogate estate, largely illiquid property, seeks £22,000 to cover inheritance tax and legal fees before the grant of probate is issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for the Harrogate estate. We have noted the gross estate value of approximately £614,000 and the £22,000 requested for inheritance tax and fees pending the grant. To take this further we would need details of the deceased, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, confirmation of the executors and whether any other charges exist over the property, plus the IHT payment deadline and any application reference. A member of the team will be in touch once we have reviewed the information provided.
